items.headline: Special Weather Statement issued September 19 at 5:33PM EDT by NWS Tampa Bay Ruskin FL
items.description:
At 533 PM EDT, Doppler radar was tracking a strong thunderstorm near
Parrish, or 10 miles east of Palmetto, moving southwest at 20 mph.

HAZARD...Wind gusts up to 50 mph.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Gusty winds could knock down tree limbs and blow around
unsecured objects.

Locations impacted include...
Sarasota, Bradenton, Palmetto, Longboat Key, Siesta Key, Lakewood
Ranch, Ellenton, Sarasota Springs, South Gate Ridge, Lake Sarasota,
Saint Armands Key, North Sarasota, Memphis, Sarasota Bradenton
Airport, West Samoset, Southgate, Gulf Gate Estates, Myakka River
State Park, The Meadows, and Ridge Wood Heights.
items.instruction:
If outdoors, consider seeking shelter inside a building.

Torrential rainfall is also occurring with this storm and may lead to
localized flooding. Do not drive your vehicle through flooded
roadways.

items.headline: Special Marine Warning issued September 19 at 5:30PM EDT until September 19 at 6:30PM EDT by NWS Tampa Bay Ruskin FL
items.description:
SMWTBW

The National Weather Service in Ruskin has issued a

* Special Marine Warning for...
Coastal waters from Englewood to Tarpon Springs FL out 20 NM...
Tampa Bay waters...

* Until 630 PM EDT.

* At 529 PM EDT, a severe thunderstorm capable of producing
waterspouts was located near Sarasota Bay, moving south at 15
knots.

HAZARD...Waterspouts and wind gusts 34 knots or greater.

SOURCE...Radar.

IMPACT...Waterspouts can quickly form and capsize boats, damage
vessels, and create suddenly higher waves. Make sure all
on board are in a secure location and wearing life
jackets. Expect wind gusts in excess of 34 knots,
suddenly higher waves, frequent lightning, and heavy
downpours. Make sure all on board are wearing life
jackets.

* Locations impacted include...
Terra Ceia Bay, Manatee Nearshore Reef, Longboat Key, Venice Inlet,
M4 Reef, Siesta Key, M7 Reef, Saint Armands Key, M8 Reef, M17 Reef,
Big Sarasota Pass, M5 Reef, M1 Reef, Holmes Beach, Port Manatee
Reef, Manatee 1 Mile Reef, Manatee 3 Mile South Reef, Bradenton
Beach, Sarasota Bay Hart Reef, and Longboat Pass.
items.instruction: Move to safe harbor until hazardous weather passes.
